title: Senior Engineer - Software Development
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
=============================

**Software Development**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core.
* Develop responsive and reusable user interfaces using React and JavaScript.
* Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET Core.
* Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code following established coding standards and design principles.
* Work with SQL databases to design queries, stored procedures, database objects, and optimize application data access.
* Analyze and troubleshoot application issues across frontend, backend, and database layers.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development and quality standards.

**Architecture \& Technical Design**
------------------------------------

* Contribute to application architecture and technical design decisions.
* Design scalable and maintainable application components following appropriate design patterns and principles.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and implement appropriate optimization strategies.
* Evaluate tech
* Evaluate technical approaches and recommend solutions based on scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Participate in modernization and technology migration initiatives where required.

**Quality \& Engineering Practices**
------------------------------------

* Develop unit and integration tests to ensure application reliability and maintainability.
* Investigate defects and production issues and implement effective root\-cause fixes.
* Follow secure coding practices and contribute to application security improvements.
* Maintain technical documentation for application components and solutions.
* Collaborate with QA teams to support functional, regression, performance, and integration testing.

**Collaboration \& Leadership**
-------------------------------

* Work closely with Product Managers, Architects, Business Analysts, QA and other engineering teams.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers.
* Conduct and participate in technical and code reviews.
* Communicate technical issues, solutions, and progress effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills**
===================

**Core — Must Have**
--------------------

* Strong hands\-on experience with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core and C\#.
* Strong hands\-on experience developing frontend applications using React.
* Practical experience with AI\-assisted software development and prompt engineering, including writing effective prompts for code generation, debugging, code review, documentation, and solution design using AI tools.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, including ES6\+ concepts and modern frontend development practices.
* Strong experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Hands\-on experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
* Good understanding of web application architecture and client\-server communication.
* Experience with software design principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Experience with debugging, performance optimization, and production issue troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of Git and source\-code management practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum software development environment.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Java and/or Java\-based backend applications.
* Exposure to NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or equivalent.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
* Exposure to Docker and containerized application deployment.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and tools.
* Exposure to application monitoring, logging, and performance analysis tools.
* Experience with microservices architecture.
* Knowledge of secure application development and OWASP principles.

**Education**
=============


Bachelor's or Master's degree in one of the following fields, or equivalent practical experience:

* Computer Science
* Computer Engineering
* Information Technology
* Software Engineering
* Related technical discipline


Relevant technical certifications are considered a plus.

**Experience**
==============

* 4–7 years of hands\-on industry experience in software development.
* Demonstrable experience building and maintaining enterprise\-grade web applications using .NET Core and React.
* Strong experience working across frontend, backend, and SQL/database layers.
* Experience participating in technical design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Experience working in Agile development environments and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical decision\-making.


What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

title: Project Manager -Scrum Master - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Job Summary**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-driven professional to perform a hybrid role of **Project Manager, and Scrum Master**. The ideal candidate will bridge business and technology teams, drive project delivery, facilitate Agile practices, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, leadership skills, and hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery.

  

  

**Responsibilities:**


**Project Manager Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans and roadmaps.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including business, technology, operations, and vendors.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, quality standards, and budget.
* Facilitate decision\-making by providing project insights, metrics, and recommendations.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and manage expectations throughout project execution.
* Identify and mitigate project risks and implement corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance, change management, and delivery frameworks.

**Scrum Master Responsibilities**


* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum principles, Agile best practices, and continuous improvement.
* Remove impediments and blockers impacting team productivity and sprint commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and self\-organization within the team.
* Monitor sprint progress and ensure delivery commitments are achieved.
* Use Agile metrics such as Velocity, Burndown Charts, and Sprint Health indicators to improve team performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote Agile maturity across teams

**Recommended Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of experience in project manager experience.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively use complex analytical, interpretive and problem\-solving techniques
* Proven interpersonal, diplomatic and influencing skills
* Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication

**Professional Certifications**


* PMP (Project Management Professional) – PMI
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
* PMI\-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner)

**Education:**


* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Lead Software Automation Test Engineer (Java, Selenium)- 9+ Years
description:
**Position Type :**

Full time**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)**Job Title: Software Development Engineer in Test, SDET** .

**About FIS**


Are you curious, self\-motivated, and forward\-thinking? At FIS, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all fun.

 **About the Team**


This is an opportunity to join a talented team of functional and technical professionals working on digital banking solutions at one of the world’s leading providers of financial technology solutions. The team works across geographies and collaborates closely to deliver high\-quality, scalable, and reliable products for the financial services domain.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, SDET, who is passionate about quality engineering, test automation, and building robust automation solutions for web, API, batch, and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in automation testing, requirement analysis, test strategy, and Agile delivery.


In this role, you will analyse business requirements, participate in grooming and estimation, design and execute test strategies, identify automation opportunities, build and maintain automation scripts, and help improve product quality based on defect trends and testing outcomes.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Analyse business requirements and actively participate in requirement grooming and estimation.
* Work closely with product owners, developers, quality engineers, and cross\-functional teams to understand features and define effective test coverage.
* Develop test strategies, create test plans, and execute test cases for new features, enhancements, and production support scenarios.
* Identify manual test cases that are suitable for automation and develop automation scripts using Playwright, Selenium, and other automation tools.
* Build, maintain, innovate, and continuously improve automation frameworks, test processes, and quality engineering practices.
* Automate testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile channels to improve regression efficiency and product confidence.
* Perform API testing for SOAP and REST services using tools such as SOAP UI and Postman.
* Validate applications through functional, regression, accessibility, mobile, and microservices testing.
* Write, implement, maintain, and review automation scripts and test artifacts.
* Use SQL to construct moderate to complex queries for validating data and troubleshooting issues.
* Participate in Agile development methodologies and sprint ceremonies, including planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Track, analyse, and manage defects while recommending quality improvements based on defect patterns and root causes.
* Collaborate across geographies and teams to support delivery, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
**What You Bring**

* Strong hands\-on testing experience with a focus on automating web and API tests.
* Experience in UI automation testing, API testing, and automation script development and maintenance.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright and Katalon.
* Expertise in automation testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile applications.
* Experience developing or contributing to automation frameworks for enterprise applications.
* Experience on scripting languages such as Python, Ruby, Groovy, Shell, Perl, or similar.
* Strong understanding of manual testing concepts, test scenario design, test case writing, test artifact review, and defect management.
* Experience testing SOAP or REST APIs using SOAP UI, Postman, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with accessibility testing tools and practices such as JAWS and Level Access.
* Experience in mobile testing and web\-based application testing.
* Ability to write moderate to complex SQL queries for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of SDLC, defect management processes, and engineering tools such as Jira, Maven, Git, SOAP UI, Silk Central, BrowserStack, WinSCP, and Putty.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic to complex technical issues and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
**Technical Skills**

**Automation and Testing**

* Playwright
* Selenium
* UI automation
* API automation
* Batch automation
* Mobile automation
* Automation framework development
* Functional and non\-functional test automation
* Test case design and review
* Defect management
* Accessibility testing
* Regression testing
* Microservices testing

Supported by the original testing, automation, framework, API, UI, batch, mobile, accessibility, and microservices expectations in the source profile.

**API and Tools**

* SOAP UI
* Postman
* REST APIs
* SOAP services
* Jira
* Maven
* Git
* Silk Central
* BrowserStack
* Level Access

* Putty

Supported by the original list of testing, API, defect management, and SDLC tools in the source profile.

**Scripting, CI/CD, and Engineering Tools**

* Python, Ruby, Groovy, Shell, or Perl
* Jenkins
* CI/CD concepts
* SonarQube
* SVN
* Maven or Gradle
* Checkmarx
* YourKit Profiler
* IBM Heap Analyzer

Supported by the original good\-to\-have skills and tool expectations.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AI tools and technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD and Jenkins.
* Experience with public cloud environments such as AWS.
* Experience in penetration testing and performance testing.
* Experience in unit testing and automated functional or non\-functional testing.
* Knowledge of banking or financial domain applications.
* CSTE, CSQA, or ISTQB Advanced Level certification.
* Working experience with Agile development and Test\-Driven Development.
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.
* 3\-5\+ years of relevant testing and technical experience in a Quality Engineer, SDET, or test automation role.
**Competencies**

* Fluent in English.
* Excellent communicator with the ability to discuss technical and business\-focused solutions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of producing high\-quality documentation.
* Organized approach with the ability to manage and adapt priorities based on client and internal requirements.
* Self\-starter with a team mindset and the ability to work independently as well as part of a global team.
* Strong team player with interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities.
**What We Offer You**


At FIS, we value your expertise and offer growth opportunities, a competitive compensation and benefits package, and a casual work environment. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the transformation of Digital Banking through strong engineering, automation, and quality practices.
